description: Produce a one-time link (valid 5 minutes) that opens the live Tachka.ru checkout in a browser with this cart pre-loaded and the city pre-selected. Use it to hand the purchase to a human instead of placing the order yourself; checkout on the site re-validates live prices.

city_id.description: The delivery city; the opened checkout pre-selects it. Default: 414 (Moscow).

name: get_checkout_url

checkout_url.description: One-time link, valid 5 minutes. Opens the live checkout with the cart pre-loaded.
